name: Gonti, Canny Acquisitor
oracle_text:
Spells you cast but don't own cost {1} less to cast.
Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, look at the top card of that player's library, then exile it face down. You may play that card for as long as it remains exiled, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell.
blocked_sentences: Spells you cast but don't own cost {1} less to cast.

needs.what: an ownership clause on spell_cost_reduction's affects_spells filter: "spells you cast but don't own" discounts a spell only when its caster is not its owner (owner: "opponent" / not_owner: "you"), read off the object being cast (its owner, not its printed face), so a stolen card cast from exile, an opponent's graveyard or library, or a spell cast via cast_card from an opponent's zone all get the {1} discount and the caster's own cards never do
needs.why_existing_wont_do: spell_cost_reduction's affects_spells takes SPELL_COST_REDUCTION_FILTER_KEYS (controller, types, colors, name, mana_cost, exclude_self, power, from_zone, not_from_zone ...) and has no owner key; player_statics.spell_cost_reduction is handed a CardDef and matches it through _matches_printed, so it cannot see who owns the object. from_zone: exile is the nearest spelling and is wrong both ways: it discounts your own cards cast from exile (foretell, impulse draw, adventure) and misses an opponent's card cast from their graveyard or library
